versions.changelog:
- Added support for searching match and attraction tickets via flyai within the pilgrimage guide.
- Updated "Use when" to include ticket search requests for matches and attractions.
- Improved itinerary generation: now recommends and searches for match tickets automatically when a home match is found during the trip.
- No code functionality changed; only one project settings file was removed.

football-pilgrimage 1.0.1

- Added project configuration file `.idea/workspace.xml` for improved IDE setup and collaboration.
- No changes to core skill logic or user-facing features.

Football Pilgrimage Guide skill — initial release:

- Generates rich, narrative-driven football pilgrimage guides for any team, including stadiums, museums, fan pubs, and cultural landmarks, each with their own story.
- "On This Day" feature matches travel dates to historical football events tied to the team.
- Automatically detects if live matches occur during the user’s trip.
- Displays the chosen team’s official crest and uses extensive web search for spot/city history.
- Smart pre-checks for missing team and travel date: prompts users or recommends iconic destinations and optimal travel times based on match schedule and historic events.
- Fully matches user’s input language for all prompts and output.
